entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Yeah, this VeloBand Pulse you sent me is a piece of absolute garbage. It doesn't work and I want my money back. Now.
I'm very sorry to hear you're having trouble with your VeloBand Pulse. To make sure I understand correctly, is it a technical fault with the device or is it just not meeting your expectations?
It's a fault! It doesn't track anything right. I'm telling you, the product is defective. I really don't have time for a million questions, I just want a refund.

I understand your frustration completely. For any defect claims, the first step is to connect you with our technical support team. They can quickly verify the issue and if a fault is confirmed, they can authorize a replacement or a return for you. Would it be okay if I transfer you?
No! I'm not talking to another person. I am not a beta tester for your company. I paid for a working product and I got garbage. I don't want a replacement, I just want money back. It's simple.

I hear you, and I do want to help resolve this. However, our policy requires that a defect be verified by our technical team before we can process a return for that reason. Without that verification, the return would fall under our standard policy.
Fine. Whatever. Process it under the standard policy. I don't care how you do it, just get it done.

Okay. Looking at your account, I see the VeloBand Pulse was delivered 14 days ago, on December 29th. For the Pulse specifically, due to its hygiene and account activation protocols, we have a strict 10-day return window. Since we're on day 14, it's outside that period for a standard return.

Are you serious?! Ten days? What kind of a policy is that? This is a scam! I want to speak to your manager right now. This is completely unacceptable and I will be posting about this experience everywhere.

I understand your frustration, and I am the highest point of contact available on this call. The 10-day policy for the VeloBand Pulse is stated on the product page and in our terms of service. Because you're outside that window and are declining the option to verify the defect with our technical team, I am unable to authorize a refund. My only option remains to transfer you to technical support.
Unbelievable. You sell broken junk and then hide behind a policy. You're going to lose a customer over this. Just forget it. This is a waste of my time.
